title: Cell Scan
desc: One-button LTE band sweep: probe B20/B8/B3/B1/B7 for in-band power, then capture a 15.36 MSps burst on every carrier above threshold and decode MIB/PCFICH/PDCCH/PDSCH/SIB1 offline - PCI, operator (from the PLMN), TAC, cellIdentity + eNB/sector, bandwidth, ports, frequency and receive power per cell. An explicit frequency list still works. RX-only, no lease at rest - the lease is held only while a sweep or scan runs.
